athlete.name: Patrick
athlete.zoneSource: Garmin LTHR 172 - single source for every page

zones.name: Easy
zones.use: Easy and long runs - most of your km

zones.name: Aerobic
zones.use: Grey zone - avoid on easy days

baseline.name: asics META:Time:Trials 10K
baseline.note: Negative split - last 2 km at 5:33 and 5:23 with HR only 168-170. There was more in the tank.

races.name: Thailand Post EMS RUN 2026
races.place: Bangkok Central Post Office, Bang Rak

plan.cue: Let the crowd go. This is the only way to lose the race.
Lock in. Cadence 170+. Drink at every station without stopping.

races.rule: Through 5 km in 29:00 or faster and breathing is controlled: hold 5:45 and finish hard. Slower than 29:30 at 5 km: settle for beating 59:15.

races.name: Saucony BKK10K

plan.cue: Settle. You have run this pace before.

races.rule: Go for sub-57 only if (1) the Oct 9 test passed, (2) EMS was 58:00 or faster, and (3) the Oct 20 recovery run HR was normal. Otherwise run the EMS pacing again and target sub-58.

checkpoints.name: 3 x 2 km threshold
checkpoints.pass: Reps at 6:00-6:10, rep 3 HR 168 or lower

checkpoints.name: 4 x 1.5 km at goal pace
checkpoints.pass: Reps at 5:40-5:45, rep 4 HR 173 or lower, effort 8/10

checkpoints.name: Recovery run HR
checkpoints.pass: Within 5 bpm of usual easy HR at the same pace

2026-09-27.name: Long run - 11 easy + 3 steady
2026-09-27.why: Last long run with a race-specific finish. The easy part must stay under 151 - your recent long runs drifted to 155-159, which turns them into medium-hard days.
steps: 11 km easy, HR cap 151. If HR passes 151, slow down - do not hold pace.
3 km steady at 6:05-6:15/km, HR 158-165.
Walk 3 min, stretch calves and hips.

2026-09-28.name: Strength B - glutes and core
2026-09-28.why: Moderate. Hip thrust, side plank, dead bug, single-leg bridge. Stop 2 reps short of failure.

2026-09-29.name: Easy 8 km + 4 strides
2026-09-29.why: Easy means Z2. Finish with 4 x 20 s relaxed strides to keep turnover.
steps: 7.5 km easy, HR 136-151
4 x 20 s strides at about 5:20/km, walk 40 s between

2026-09-30.name: Easy 5 km
2026-09-30.why: Recovery run. Short, very easy, cadence 170+.

2026-10-01.name: Strength A - light
2026-10-01.why: Light lower-body stability only. Friday is the key session of the week.

2026-10-02.name: Key session 1 - 3 x 2 km threshold
2026-10-02.why: Threshold is the limiter for a sub-58 10K. Program it as a Garmin structured workout so each rep is its own lap - km splits hide rep pace.
steps: 2 km warm-up easy, then 4 x 20 s strides
3 x 2 km at 6:00-6:10/km (treadmill 9.8-10.0 km/h), 2 min easy jog between
1.5 km cool-down
Pass: all 3 reps on pace with rep 3 averaging HR 168 or lower

2026-10-04.name: Long run - 14 km easy
2026-10-04.why: Pure aerobic long run. No fast finish this week - Friday carries the intensity.
steps: 14 km easy, HR cap 151 the whole way
If outdoors, start before 6:00 to beat the heat

2026-10-05.name: Strength B - short
2026-10-05.why: Half the usual sets. No soreness allowed this close to racing.

2026-10-06.name: Easy 7 km + 4 strides
2026-10-06.why: Steady easy run with strides at the end.
steps: 6.5 km easy, HR 136-151
4 x 20 s strides, walk 40 s between

2026-10-07.name: Easy 5 km
2026-10-07.why: Very easy. Legs should feel fresher by the end of this week.

2026-10-08.name: Mobility only
2026-10-08.why: 8-10 min piriformis, hip flexor and calf mobility. No weights.

2026-10-09.name: Key session 2 - race-pace test 4 x 1.5 km
2026-10-09.why: This session decides the Saucony target. It is 6 km at goal pace with short breaks - if you can hold it under control now, sub-57 is realistic on race day with taper and adrenaline.
steps: 2 km warm-up + 4 x 20 s strides
4 x 1.5 km at 5:40-5:45/km (treadmill 10.5-10.6 km/h), 90 s easy jog between
1 km cool-down
Pass for sub-57: all reps on pace, rep 4 HR 173 or lower, effort 8/10 not 10/10
If reps 3-4 slip above 5:50 or HR goes past 175: Saucony target is sub-58

2026-10-11.name: Easy 10 km + strides
2026-10-11.why: Last longer run. Volume drops from here, intensity stays.
steps: 9.5 km easy
4 x 20 s strides

2026-10-13.name: Sharpener - 3 x 1 km at race pace
2026-10-13.why: Keeps race pace familiar without adding fatigue.
steps: 2 km easy
3 x 1 km at 5:40-5:45/km, 2 min jog between
1 km easy

2026-10-16.name: Shakeout 3 km + 4 x 200 m
2026-10-16.why: Short and sharp. Wake the legs up, do not tire them.
steps: 3 km easy
4 x 200 m at 5:15-5:25/km, full walk recovery

2026-10-17.name: Race eve - rest
2026-10-17.why: Lay out kit, pin bib, set the 3:00 alarm. Start is 04:00. Dinner by 19:00, bed by 21:00.

2026-10-18.name: EMS RUN 10K - race 1
2026-10-18.why: Run it on HR and effort. Goal sub-58. Details on the Race tab.

2026-10-20.name: Recovery 5 km
2026-10-20.why: Check: if HR at this pace is more than 5 bpm above your usual easy HR, you are still carrying the race - drop Saucony to the B target.

2026-10-21.name: Rest or 3 km easy
2026-10-21.why: Optional 3 km very easy if legs feel good.

2026-10-22.name: Easy 5 km with 4 x 1 min race pace
2026-10-22.why: Reminds the legs of race pace.
steps: 2 km easy
4 x 1 min at 5:40/km, 1 min easy between
1.5 km easy

2026-10-24.name: Race eve shakeout 3 km
2026-10-24.why: Start is 05:00. 3 km easy + 3 x 100 m strides, then feet up.
steps: 3 km easy
3 x 100 m relaxed strides

2026-10-25.name: Saucony BKK10K - race 2
2026-10-25.why: Goal race. Target set by the Oct 9 test and the EMS result.
